method.name: SetXOrigin
method.description: defines the x Origin of the grid.

method.name: SetYOrigin
method.description: defines the y Origin of the grid.

method.name: SetRotationAngle
method.description: defines the orientation of the grid.

method.name: Rotate
method.description: Rotate the grid from a relative angle.

method.name: Translate
method.description: Translate the grid from a relative distance.

method.name: SetColors
method.description: Change the colors of the grid

method.name: Hit
method.description: returns the point of the grid the closest to the point X,Y if the grid is active. If the grid is not active returns X,Y.

method.name: Activate
method.description: activates the grid. The Hit method will return gridx and gridx computed according to the steps of the grid.

method.name: Deactivate
method.description: deactivates the grid. The hit method will return gridx and gridx as the enter value X & Y.

method.name: XOrigin
method.description: returns the x Origin of the grid.

method.name: YOrigin
method.description: returns the x Origin of the grid.

method.name: RotationAngle
method.description: returns the x Angle of the grid.

method.name: IsActive
method.description: Returns TRUE when the grid is active.

method.name: Colors
method.description: Returns the colors of the grid.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
